title: Stackelberg Games with a Robust Leader
summary: In this paper we study a Stackelberg game with one leader and multiple followers. Given the leader's control, the followers solve a Nash game with possibly multiple equilibria. We consider a robust leader who considers the worst scenario, namely the followers would select the equilibrium worst for the leader. By using the weak formulation, the problem induces a zero sum game problem with open loop controls, which is time inconsistent.
